strings: r_c0 notices that m_c keeps whimpering in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} sleep. r_c0 tries to check m_c for injuries, but m_c reveals {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} fine- physically, at least.

r_c0 wakes up to m_c screaming. {PRONOUN/r_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/r_c/shake/shakes} m_c awake. m_c curls up and refuses to talk about what happened in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} sleep, but something really rattled {PRONOUN/m_c/object} in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} sleep.
m_c wakes up in a cold sweat. Visions of what could be- No. What definitely IS going to happen plague {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} mind.
